headline: The 49ers Are Climbing Fast
caption:
On Sep 8, San Francisco had a 4% chance to win the Super Bowl in our model. Today: 14%.

That 10-point jump is the biggest rise on the board. Kansas City is close behind, going from 2% to 10%, and Minnesota went from 4% to 10%. Jacksonville peaked at 13% but has settled at 9%, still up from 6%. New England is right where it started, at 7%.

Our model simulates the rest of the season and the playoffs thousands of times each day. Who climbs next?
